packaging: Pinned project Nix dotnet-sdk_10; framework-dependent Release IL, original tiered compilation/PGO, workstation concurrent GC, no ReadyToRun. Offline build-time SDK framework restore with cleared package feeds; no runtime build/restore/download. Native fzclr uses declared project compiler, pthreads, -O2 -ffp-contract=off on each native architecture.
profiles: Inherited language native/default DR/public observer comparison. x86 CLR copy of translator_observe, with libcoreclr.so filename check and exact same-runtime module path, positive app/VM execution counters required, ARM original translator_progress with instructions-per-progress-call 50000. No CLR-specific DR or application runtime flags. These are not global Seedbox opt_speed/disable_traces or ARM ldstex2cas profile qualification.
containment: Existing phase.py 600-second per-phase bound and native supervisor unchanged. Expensive reversePInvoke can exceed 120 seconds; completion is not a speed assertion.
architecture_boundary: Nix fixture package builds on native x86_64-linux and aarch64-linux with the matching SDK and native helper. Full ARM language cross-build is not part of this fixture contract. Native ARM CI must build and execute it; host IL compilation is not native ARM qualification.
pacing: Three source pacing sleeps become cooperative Thread.Yield under project test policy, as in earlier retained CLR investigations. Counts and source arithmetic/reference assertions unchanged. Tier completion does not prove tier-1 installation; original delay was also not a public tier oracle.
